title: The Ford F-Series in 5 Turning Points (And the Fire That Shook It in 2026)
description:
In twenty twenty-five, Ford sold eight hundred twenty-eight thousand, eight hundred thirty-two F-Series trucks in America. That is more than two thousand every single day. It was the forty-ninth year in a row as the country's best-selling truck. And yet, in the third quarter of twenty twenty-six, Ford lost a race it almost never loses. A fire, a sheet of aluminum, and one rival made it happen.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:34 1. 1948: the F-1 is born
4:28 2. 1975-1977: the F-150 and the sales crown
7:51 3. 1997-1999: the big gamble and Super Duty
10:41 4. 2015: the aluminum body (and the 2025 fires)
13:42 5. The electric bet and the U-turn
16:18 The 2026 truck war
20:16 What to check before you buy in 2027
